name: Yardi Virtuoso
description: Yardi Virtuoso provides secure, real-time access to Yardi data and tools through Claude. It enables investment, property and asset management professionals to query financial models, predictive maintenance insights, market analysis, and portfolio data using natural language. Users can ask complex operational questions, explore strategic scenarios, and perform analysis without manual data extraction, all grounded in accurate, enterprise-grade Yardi data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Yardi Virtuoso to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Yardi Virtuoso to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.virtuoso.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Yardi Virtuoso MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yardi Virtuoso provides these MCP tools: rfm_connectai_create_work_order, rfm_connectai_search_work_orders, rfm_workorder_mark_work_order_as_complete, vn_mcpframework_get_autocomplete, and vn_mcpframework_list_autocomplete_types.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Yardi Virtuoso?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Yardi Virtuoso in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Yardi Virtuoso MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yardi Virtuoso requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Yardi Virtuoso is developed by Yardi. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
